$comment: 基础反模式规则集（starter）。复制到项目 harness/policies/anti-patterns.json 作为起点，再按项目裁剪/增补。Schema: { rules: [{ id, severity, pattern(RegExp), fileGlob, excludeGlob?, message, fix, guardPattern?, guardLookback? }] }

rules.message: Inline style object — prefer CSS classes / design tokens
rules.fix: Use className with utility/Tailwind classes, or a design-system prop

rules.message: Hardcoded hex color — prefer design tokens / CSS custom properties
rules.fix: Use var(--token-name) or theme color variable

rules.message: console.log/debug left in source — use a structured logger or remove
rules.fix: Replace with a logger (or remove for debug leftovers)
Track in your issue tracker and reference the issue id in the comment

rules.message: Potential secret / API key in source — MUST move to env / secret manager
rules.fix: Use environment variables or a secret manager; never commit keys
